loomChannelSlice.status: staged product: channel, members, private boxes, Role/instance and sidebar management, message search and read-only activity; console retained

structuralPort.behavior: AppShell column composition; authenticated Loom SDK replaces public Raft data; official compact composer added through its existing onSendOverride
structuralPort.localChanges: No Raft login, billing, remote API, or unimplemented interaction routes. Display rows remain read-only; Human text posting is active.

memberSlice.owner: Loom Kernel membership and room.agent.activity.list; client-core RoomSession owns reconciliation
memberSlice.presentation: Unmodified ChannelMemberRow/ChannelMemberListShell; raft-ui 0.5.52 Dialog primitives; local ChannelMembers composition
memberSlice.localChanges: No upstream agentId/status store; execution text is not online presence. Only poll while open; failed reads clear stale labels. No member-management mutation.

privateBoxSlice.owner: Existing room.direct.open via control RoomSession and WriteIntentSlot; box MessageSession owns bounded history
privateBoxSlice.presentation: Same unmodified official MessageTimeline/MessageItem/compact MessageInput and member row trailing action
privateBoxSlice.localChanges: Names and direct-room routing; explicit unknown open/send verification; room.list provides private-box availability; inactive boxes read-only; Side excluded
privateBoxSlice.limits: No full DM sidebar, attachments, Side controls, or private RunAttempt inspector; console retained

instanceAddSlice.owner: Existing role.list / role.instantiate; shared channel RoomSession and WriteIntentSlot
instanceAddSlice.presentation: Unchanged official ChannelMemberListShell/ChannelMemberRow and raft-ui Dialog/Button; local Role picker
instanceAddSlice.localChanges: Create a new Role instance, allowing repeated Role use in a channel; Kernel assigns name and freezes revision. Unknown result retains target and exact request until explicit verification.
instanceAddSlice.limits: Role creation/edit/delete and instance restart/remove now also available on Agent page; advanced lifecycle/inspection remains console-only.

navigationShell.owner: Local URL view selects presentation only; existing channel client-core owners remain mounted across page changes
navigationShell.structuralPort: Official LeftRail desktop grouping and MainLayout in-flow mobile navigation; authenticated Loom URL targets replace upstream server/account stores
navigationShell.localChanges: Six sections: Search, Channels, Activity, Tasks, Agent, Settings. Desktop Settings footer retained. Mobile exposes the same six destinations instead of upstream four tabs. Agent denotes Role/instance management; unfinished pages explicitly unavailable with console link; no unread/status/account fixtures.
navigationShell.limits: Tasks/Settings remain placeholders; Search and read-only Activity connected, Agent management connected. Console retained for advanced capabilities.

managementSlice.owner: Existing role.*, instance.session.reset, room.member.remove, room.create and sidebar.get/patch; client-core RoomSession / WriteIntentSlot and shared Role form validation. No new backend state or handlers.
managementSlice.directReuse: Unmodified PublicServerSidebarFrame/Row, ChannelMemberListShell/Row, PanelHeader, FormField and raft-ui Dialog/DropdownMenu/Input/Textarea/Button.
managementSlice.localComposition: Agent Role/instance tabs and forms replace upstream single-Agent/server stores. Sidebar grouping and menus follow Sidebar.tsx / SidebarSectionDialog.tsx behavior; local typed SDK projection and native select fields are local glue, not byte-exact reuse of whole pages.
managementSlice.behavior: Role create/revise/delete; frozen instances instantiate/restart keep-or-adopt/remove; channel creation with optional fixed attached paths; custom groups create/rename/delete/move, pin/unpin, section and row manual ordering, name/recent ordering; durable per-Human preferences with expectedVersion, exact unknown-write replay, rejected concurrent patches reload without overwrite.
managementSlice.limits: Manual ordering uses menu up/down, not upstream drag/drop. No joint/public channels or full official Agent details; archive/read/mute controls are connected by sidebarActionsSlice. Section collapse is transient presentation state. No paid CLI calls.

discoverySlice.owner: Existing search/activity.list/message.context plus client-core RoomSession; server owns ACL, keyset cursors and activity/unread calculation. No backend changes.
discoverySlice.directReuse: raft-ui SearchShell/Results/EntityResult, ActivityInboxPanel, Dialog and Input/Button; unchanged official PanelHeader and read-only MessageItem.
discoverySlice.structuralPort: MessageSearchPage search/filter/result composition and ThreadsInbox panel; Loom SDK data and lightweight URL parameters replace Raft stores/account APIs. Local composition is not a byte-exact copy of either full page.
discoverySlice.behavior: 20-result pages replace rather than append; search scope all/channel/direct/thread; recent ordering; query/filter survive reload; same-query submit resets to first page; late aborted reads cannot replace current results; errors remove stale content; exact message context from bounded authenticated API, with root/message deduplication; open parent conversation at latest history. Agent Role/instance name filtering is presentation-only.
discoverySlice.limits: Message text search only, no entity search or advanced author/date filters. Activity filters all/unread/mentions are read-only and do not mark read or follow/unfollow. Context has no thread reply, attachment interaction or live message subscription. Opening parent conversation is not an anchored jump to the old result.

sidebarInteractionSlice.source: packages/web/src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx section header, renderSectionAddButton and row context-menu wiring; SidebarSortMenu.tsx ArrowUpDown trigger
sidebarInteractionSlice.directReuse: raft-ui ContextMenu and DropdownMenu primitives; unchanged PublicServerSidebarFrame/Row
sidebarInteractionSlice.structuralPort: Section icon button and heading class parameters, ArrowUpDown/Plus/ChevronRight icons; removed redundant title and row ellipsis; channel and group operations use right-click menus.
sidebarInteractionSlice.localChanges: Existing Loom sidebar mutation contracts retained. Context menu keyboard shortcut and native touch long-press; sort modes remain existing shared channel/custom-group preference and separate pinned preference. Plus creates a channel in the default list; moving into a custom group remains explicit.
sidebarInteractionSlice.limits: No drag/drop. Custom groups do not acquire independent sort state. Source files remain byte-exact. Archive/read/mute added by sidebarActionsSlice.

sidebarActionsSlice.source: packages/web/src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx surface menu, move-to-section submenu, channel read/pin/mute/archive actions and archive confirmation; SidebarReadToggleMenuItem.tsx
sidebarActionsSlice.owner: Existing room.create/sidebar.get/patch/activity.list/mark/room.archive/unarchive; RoomSession and WriteIntentSlot for causal/idempotent writes. No backend or protocol changes.
sidebarActionsSlice.directReuse: raft-ui ContextMenu/Submenu/Dialog/Button/Input and unchanged official channel rows/timeline/composer; no upstream file modified.
sidebarActionsSlice.localComposition: Blank surface create-channel/create-section/archive-list; move submenu plus atomically create-and-move section; unread/mute projections; archive confirmation/list/restore with read-only history. Existing reserved #all and active-work checks remain authoritative.
sidebarActionsSlice.failureHandling: Sidebar and lifecycle writes retain exact retry identity after lost response. Activity marks have no idempotency API and are never automatically replayed; error tells user to refresh/reassess state. Late reads are ignored.
sidebarActionsSlice.limits: Only top-level channel read state; thread read state stays independent. Latest top-level unread frontier scan capped at ten 100-message pages; if not found, no mutation. No automatic mark-read just by viewing. Shared channel/custom-group sort preference retained; no drag/drop.

rollout.ownerDecision: 2026-10-14: deploy Web in stages for visual inspection; channel text slice first; incomplete capabilities remain in console.
